name: File
description: Uploads files by dropping or browsing: a native file input over a drop zone, and a list of the chosen files with their size, progress, errors and a remove button. Livewire uploads through wire:model on the native input.

livewire.name: file
differences: The list reads the wire:model property's uploads (or value), and its remove buttons call $removeUpload for temporary uploads. Upload progress comes from Livewire's upload events.

react.name: File
differences: The list shows the chosen files unless value is given.

vue.name: File
differences: Exported as File (FileUpload stays as a deprecated alias). The list shows the chosen files unless v-model is bound.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label above the drop zone, for the native input.

props.name: title
props.description: The drop zone's main line. Translated by default.

props.name: hint
props.description: Limits under the title (types, size, count), linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.
props.a11y: Sets aria-invalid on the native input.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the input and the drop zone.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required on the native input.

props.name: accept
props.description: The accepted types, as the native accept attribute.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The largest file in bytes, for scripts and the hint to read. Emitted as data-max-size; validate sizes on the server (or in value-change) and pass errors back through value entries.

props.name: variant
props.description: A large centered drop zone, or a compact row. Emitted as data-variant.

props.name: value
props.description: The files to list: File objects, Livewire uploads, or { name, size, progress, error } entries. Without it React and Vue list the files the user chose.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Each remove button's accessible name, with a :name placeholder. Translated by default.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { dropzone: '…', item: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, drop zone, file list and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the native input.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the input is required.

parts.name: dropzone
parts.description: The dashed area. data-state="drag" while files are dragged over it.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native input type=file, transparent over the drop zone, so a click browses and a drop chooses. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: item
parts.description: One file. data-state="error" when it failed or is too large.

parts.name: name
parts.description: The file name, truncated with an ellipsis.

parts.name: meta
parts.description: The size, or the file's error.

parts.name: progress
parts.description: The native progress bar while a file uploads.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: The remove button, labelled with the file name.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The chosen files changed: chosen, dropped or removed. Livewire uploads them through wire:model.

events.name: remove
events.description: A file's remove button was pressed, with the file or entry. Livewire removes its temporary uploads itself and dispatches remove for other entries, with { index, name }.

keyboard.action: Moves to the file input, then each remove button.
Opens the file dialog, or removes a file.

requirements: The native input type=file stays in the DOM, transparent over the drop zone, so it is keyboard and screen-reader operable; drag and drop is an enhancement the platform supplies.
The label, title and hint name and describe the input; error is linked with aria-describedby.
Each remove button is labelled with its file's name.
Progress is a native progress element; a file's error shows in its meta text, not by color alone.
Visible focus ring on the drop zone while the input has :focus-visible.
State the limits (types, size, count) before upload, and never reject a whole batch for one bad file.

value.name: floor-plan.heic
value.error: HEIC isn't supported. Use JPG or PNG.

parts.hint: JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB each.
